crossRefs.note: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you…
For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

translations.web: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
translations.bsb: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
translations.kjv: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate
translations.asv: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
